required_changes.change: Make the sole assignment exception an independent invariant: before PK-6b the exclusive map is empty; from PK-6b its only key is G21c and the only wfx row is (Finalization_Decide, G21c, O). Validate that identity and its declared type/region/assignments against the normative G21c protocol independently of matching mutable tile/gate entries. Add an amendment control for an added, relabelled or moved wfx exception, plus positive controls for the unchanged staged tables. Preserve every current gate, branch payload, diagnostic, refusal code, assignment, write and accepted case.
required_changes.reason: BR7 admits assignment exceptions by an arbitrary row's wfx kind and CAPI_GATE_EXCLUSIVE.get(row_id); neither row validation nor the outer loop enforces the normative sole exception identity. The current fixed table is correct, but the advertised independent invariant across reviewed tile/table amendments is incomplete.

required_changes.change: Extend R-QUAL(d), BR6, the closure argument, promises and machine twin to examine every potentially capturing library-unit prefix mentioned by each with clause, including ancestor units mentioned through a named descendant. Define the text-only refusal without changing the scoped exception or use-clause inventory. Add a matching amendment control and an unchanged-context positive control. Keep installed integrated name/overload resolution OPEN.
required_changes.reason: The normative with-clause restriction and BR6 check only the named dotted unit's last identifier. Ada RM 10.1.2(6/2,7) also gives visibility to library units denoted by prefixes. A capturing sibling child mentioned only as a prefix of a named descendant is outside that test, so the asserted no-capture conclusion does not follow from the rule.
